title: Current Collector
description: Current collector material and quantitative properties.

name.description: Product label of the current collector as written in the source (e.g. 'Al foil 15 um', 'Cu foil'); the JSON-LD emitter derives material and form classes from it when they are recognisable.

material.description: Substrate material of the current collector (e.g. 'Al', 'Cu', 'Ni', 'stainless steel', 'carbon-coated Al').

form.description: Physical form of the current collector.

material_spec_id.description: Optional canonical IRI of a standalone material-spec for the current-collector foil material.

supplier.description: Supplier or vendor the item was sourced from.

property.description: Named quantity map of current-collector properties (e.g. thickness, areal_mass, width). See the property keys reference for the full list of recognised keys.
